001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller;
002
003import android.Manifest.permission;
004import android.app.Dialog;
005import android.content.Context;
006import android.net.Uri;
007import android.os.Bundle;
008import android.util.TypedValue;
009import android.view.LayoutInflater;
010import android.view.View;
011import android.view.ViewGroup;
012import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
013import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
014import androidx.annotation.ColorInt;
015import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
016import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
017import androidx.core.content.FileProvider;
018import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity;
019import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner;
020import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider;
021import com.google.android.material.bottomsheet.BottomSheetDialogFragment;
022import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint;
023import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
024import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.databinding.FragmentEditBinding;
025import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
026import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.ImageFileProvider;
027import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.PermissionsViewModel;
028import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.PinViewModel;
029import java.io.File;
030import java.util.UUID;
031
032@AndroidEntryPoint
033public class EditFragment extends BottomSheetDialogFragment {
034
035  private static final String TAG = EditFragment.class.getSimpleName();
036  private static final String AUTHORITY = ImageFileProvider.class.getName().toLowerCase();
037
038  private FragmentEditBinding binding;
039  private PinViewModel pinViewModel;
040  private PermissionsViewModel permissionsViewModel;
041  private long pinId;
042  private Pin pin;
043  private ActivityResultLauncher<Uri> captureLauncher;
044  private Uri uri;
045
046  @Override
047  public void onCreate(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
048    super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
049    pinId = EditFragmentArgs.fromBundle(getArguments()).getPinId();
050    // Read any input arguments.
051  }
052
053  @NonNull
054  @Override
055  public Dialog onCreateDialog(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
056    // TODO: 2/18/25 Inflate layout and construct & return dialog containing layout.
057    return super.onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState);
058  }
059
060  @Nullable
061  @Override
062  public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container,
063      @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
064    // Return root element of layout.
065    binding = FragmentEditBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
066    // Attach listeners to UI widgets.
067    binding.cancel.setOnClickListener((v) -> dismiss());
068    binding.save.setOnClickListener((v) -> save());
069    binding.capture.setOnClickListener((v) -> capture());
070    return binding.getRoot();
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
075    super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
076    // Connect to viewmodel(s) and observe LiveData.
077    FragmentActivity activity = requireActivity();
078    ViewModelProvider provider = new ViewModelProvider(activity);
079    pinViewModel = provider.get(PinViewModel.class);
080    LifecycleOwner owner = getViewLifecycleOwner();
081    if (pinId != 0) {
082      pinViewModel.fetch(pinId);
083      pinViewModel
084          .getPin()
085          .observe(owner, this::handlePin);
086    } else {
087      // TODO: 2/18/25 Configure UI for a new pin vs. editing an existing pin.
088      binding.image.setVisibility(View.GONE);
089      pin = new Pin();
090      uri = null;
091      pinViewModel.clearCaptureUri();
092    }
093    pinViewModel
094        .getCaptureUri()
095        .observe(owner, this::handleCaptureUri);
096    permissionsViewModel = provider.get(PermissionsViewModel.class);
097    permissionsViewModel
098        .getPermissionsStatus()
099        .observe(owner, (permissions) -> {
100          //noinspection DataFlowIssue
101          binding.capture.setVisibility(permissions.getOrDefault(permission.CAMERA, false) ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
102        });
103    captureLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
104        new ActivityResultContracts.TakePicture(), pinViewModel::confirmCapture);
105  }
106
107  @Override
108  public void onDestroyView() {
109    binding = null; // Set binding reference(s) to null.
110    super.onDestroyView();
111  }
112
113  /**
114   * @noinspection DataFlowIssue
115   */
116  private void save() {
117    pin.setTitle(binding.title
118        .getText()
119        .toString()
120        .strip());
121    pin.setContent(binding.content
122        .getText()
123        .toString()
124        .strip());
125    pin.setImage(uri);
126    // TODO: 2/18/25 Set/modify the createdOn/modifiedOn.
127    pinViewModel.savePin(pin);
128    dismiss();
129  }
130
131  private void handleCaptureUri(Uri uri) {
132    if (uri != null) {
133      this.uri = uri;
134      pin.setImage(uri);
135      binding.image.setImageURI(uri);
136      binding.image.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
137    }
138  }
139
140  private void handlePin(Pin pin) {
141    this.pin = pin;
142    binding.title.setText(pin.getTitle());
143    binding.content.setText(pin.getContent());
144    Uri imageURI = pin.getImage();
145    if (imageURI != null) {
146      binding.image.setImageURI(imageURI);
147      binding.image.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
148    } else {
149      binding.image.setVisibility(View.GONE);
150    }
151    uri = imageURI;
152  }
153
154  @ColorInt
155  private int getThemeColor(int colorAttr) {
156    TypedValue typedValue = new TypedValue();
157    requireContext().getTheme().resolveAttribute(colorAttr, typedValue, true);
158    return typedValue.data;
159  }
160  
161  private void capture() {
162    Context context = requireContext();
163    File captureDir = new File(context.getFilesDir(), getString(R.string.capture_directory)); // Using the context, get a reference to the directory where we store captured images.
164    //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
165    captureDir.mkdir(); // Ensure that the directory exists.
166    // TODO: 2/24/25 Genetrate a random filename for captured image.
167    File captureFile;
168    do {
169      captureFile = new File(captureDir, UUID.randomUUID().toString());
170    } while (captureFile.exists());
171    Uri uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, AUTHORITY, captureFile); // Get a URI for the random file, using the provider infrastructure.
172    pinViewModel.setPendingCaptureUri(uri); // Store the URI in the viewmodel.
173    captureLauncher.launch(uri); // Launch the capture launcher.
174  }
175
176}
